archetypes.name: White-Black Constellation
archetypes.plan: Build around Underworld Coinsmith: Cast enchantments steadily to trigger constellation drain and token effects while defensive creatures prolong the game.

archetypes.name: Blue-Red Heroic
archetypes.plan: Build around Stormchaser Chimera: Target heroic creatures with tricks and Auras, keeping mana open to protect the threat and win a tempo race.

archetypes.name: Black-Green Constellation
archetypes.plan: Build around Nyx Weaver: Chain enchantments to trigger constellation repeatedly while defensive bodies buy time for the value engine.

archetypes.name: Red-White Heroic
archetypes.plan: Build around Desperate Stand: Target heroic attackers with tricks, remove key blockers, and turn one protected creature into a fast clock.

archetypes.name: Green-Blue Tempo
archetypes.plan: Build around Fleetfeather Cockatrice: Deploy efficient creatures, hold up bounce or flash threats, and keep the opponent off balance long enough to race.
